item.title: Vancouver police officers involved in deadly December shooting identified
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore (KOIN) — The officers who shot and killed a man outside a Vancouver home in late December have been named. Sixty days after the Washington Office of Independent Investigations began its review of the Dec. 27 deadly force incident in Vancouver, the officers involved were identified as Officer Sean Donaldson and Officer Christopher Holmquist. item.title: 'IM STUCK IN A DREAM': Beaverton teen took LSD before shooting wife, court docs say
item.description: A Beaverton resident accused of killing his wife in 2023 has been sentenced to more than 20 years in prison after reaching an eleventh-hour plea agreement.

item.title: Flood Warning in place for portions of Multnomah & Clackamas County
item.description: A moderate atmospheric river is pushing record-breaking rainfall totals into Western Oregon and southwest Washington, with forecasted precipitation totals expected to reach near 2 inches on Thursday for Portland, breaking the previous record set in March 2012.

item.title: UPDATES: Atmospheric river drenches PNW with record rainfall, flooding
item.description: Heavy rain is causing floods and downed power lines in the Pacific Northwest due to a moderate atmospheric river, with the National Weather Service issuing a Flood Warning for parts of Multnomah County until 2 p.m. Thursday and a Flood Watch through Friday night.
